canonical_home: reviews/vendor-licence-register.json (registered in the SSOT table in CLAUDE.md)
purpose: I8 requires: 'Before any feature exposes vendor data to end users, confirm the licence permits it AND RECORD THE FINDING.' This file is where the finding is recorded.

Its guard is __tests__/architecture/vendor-licence-register.test.ts, which FAILS when this repository reaches a host, depends on a package, or reads a host-bearing environment variable that has no row here. That is the whole mechanism: an unregistered vendor is a red test, so the question is forced BEFORE the feature ships rather than a year afterwards.
THIS_IS_NOT_THE_FINDINGS_LEDGER: reviews/findings-ledger.csv is the risk register — KNOWN UNFIXED DANGERS. This file is the licence register — RECORDED FINDINGS about what we reach out to. A vendor with no licence appears in BOTH, for different reasons, and the two must not be merged. F4.5 in the ledger is the standing risk; the yahoo-finance2 row here is the finding.
WHAT_A_ROW_DOES_NOT_MEAN: A row means the question was asked and the answer was written down. It does NOT mean the consumption or the redistribution is permitted. Six market-data vendors carry licence_status NONE_NO_AGREEMENT — a fact — alongside redistribution_position UNRESOLVED, which is a legal question no agent can close. Reading a populated register as an all-clear would invert the purpose of the file.
WHAT_THE_GUARD_DOES_NOT_CHECK: The guard checks that a judgement was RECORDED, never that it is CORRECT. Nothing stops a future author adding a market-data client and classifying it 'build-tooling'. What the guard buys is that the row appears in the diff with a name on it, which is the difference between an unexamined decision and a reviewed one. NAMED GAPS, because PARTIAL requires gaps named rather than gestured at: (1) EXPOSURE WITHOUT NEW EGRESS — rendering an already-fetched vendor field on a new surface reaches no host, adds no dependency and reads no env var, so no detector fires; the published-data kind covers only the workflow-push case, not a human committing data by hand. (2) NON-MANIFEST DEPENDENCIES — package.json and requirements*.txt are read; a vendor vendored into the tree, installed ad hoc, or pulled transitively is invisible. (3) A host assembled by string concatenation. (4) An environment variable that supplies a host but is not named like one.

licence_status_vocabulary.NONE_NO_AGREEMENT: Verified from the repo: no key, no account, no contract. A fact, not a verdict.
licence_status_vocabulary.PERMITTED: A licence has been read and permits this use. REQUIRES a non-empty licence_evidence field naming the document — the guard rejects the status without it, so it cannot be typed in to turn a test green.
licence_status_vocabulary.RESTRICTED: A licence exists and does NOT permit this use. The surface must be withdrawn.
licence_status_vocabulary.UNVERIFIED: Cannot be determined from the repo. A valid outcome, and preferable to a guess.
licence_status_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: Not a data vendor — assets, namespaces, first-party origins, outbound links, infrastructure, tooling.

lifecycle.active: Still reachable from the tree. The guard asserts these are still detected.
lifecycle.withdrawn: The surface was removed. Requires withdrawn_on and withdrawn_reason. The guard asserts a withdrawn row is NOT still detected — claiming a removal that did not happen is itself a violation.

APPEND_ONLY: Never delete a row. Withdrawing a surface is the good outcome I8 explicitly offers as the alternative to a finding; if withdrawal turned the guard red, deleting the audit trail would be the route to green. Mark it withdrawn instead.
open_and_owner_gated: Q-082 — the substantive licence question for Yahoo, CoinGecko, Kraken, Coinbase, Bybit, OKX, FRED and the Bloomberg bridge. Owner + counsel.
Q-083 — MAS/FAA posture, tightly coupled because both turn on what end users are shown.
Q-097 — until main has branch protection, this guard's red is advisory like every other check in this repo.

entries.finding: yahoo-finance2 ^3.13.2 is an UNOFFICIAL community library consuming undocumented, unauthenticated Yahoo Finance endpoints. There is no API key, token or credential for Yahoo anywhere in .env.example and no commercial agreement exists between this project and Yahoo. The position is therefore not 'we may be on the wrong tier' — there is no licence to be within the terms of. Imported by 21 modules including 14 app/api routes. PR #147 turned the stock-page news surface from synthetic to LIVE Yahoo content, descends from the commit that wrote I8, and recorded no licence finding — that omission is the event that made I8's process half VIOLATED.

entries.vendor: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
entries.finding: The risk-free rate series is fetched from the public FRED CSV endpoint with no key. FRED is a public-sector service, but series-level copyright varies by contributing source and this project has read no terms and recorded no permission. The value is not rendered raw; it is an input to Sharpe/Sortino, so a DERIVED form reaches the user. UNVERIFIED is the honest state — 'it is a government site' is a guess, not a finding.

entries.finding: LLM inference endpoint for the Python factor-mining sidecar, keyed by DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL / an operator-supplied API key. Not a market-data vendor and not wired into the Next.js tier, so no vendor MARKET data is redistributed through it. It is registered because a TypeScript-only scan would never have seen it — it lives in multi_agent_factor_mining/config.py, which is precisely why the walk covers executable source of any extension. Content SENT to this vendor (prompts derived from market data) is a separate question from content received, and is reviewed under Q-092.

entries.finding: THE HIGHEST-SEVERITY EGRESS ROW, and it was invisible to every earlier version of the guard. lib/data/bloomberg/bridgeClient.ts is a LIVE, WIRED Bloomberg path with NO URL literal and NO vendor package — the host arrives entirely through this variable. TWO routes expose it, not one: app/api/prices/route.ts:118-176 merges quotes tagged dataSource:'bloomberg', and app/api/fundamentals/[ticker]/route.ts:125-129 fetches the bridge and returns priceSources.bloomberg, which components/stock/quantlab/tabs/SummaryTab.tsx:32-35 renders as a LABELLED 'Bloomberg spot' price — while :130-131 makes displayPrice Bloomberg-derived and feeds it to buildFundamentalsPayload, so the numbers also propagate UNLABELLED into computed fundamentals. Both routes are PUBLIC (app/api/prices/route.ts:63 says so explicitly) and both set shared-cache headers (s-maxage 3 and 120), so enabling this redistributes terminal-derived data into a CDN intermediary, not merely to one caller. CORRECTION to the first version of this row: it recorded authenticated:true, which described the OUTBOUND X-Bridge-Secret and not the surface we serve. CORRECTION 2: it claimed the path is 'latent because .env.example:67 comments it out'. .env.example has no bearing on Vercel's environment — whether BLOOMBERG_BRIDGE_URL is set in production is NOT OBSERVABLE FROM THE REPO and is owner-answerable in thirty seconds. Asserting an unobservable deployment state is precisely the error this file exists to prevent. scripts/bloomberg-bridge-example.py:19 carries the operator warning in its own docstring, so ignorance is not available as a defence. NOT marked RESTRICTED: that would be a legal conclusion an agent may not draw, and the terms are not in the repository to read.

entries.finding: CORRECTED after review; the first version said end_user_exposed:false, authenticated:true and NOT_APPLICABLE, and all three were wrong. Auth on this route is POST-ONLY (app/api/trading-agents/[ticker]/route.ts:189-197); the GET at :56-87 is rate-limited but UNAUTHENTICATED and returns the cached analysis to anyone. That analysis is yfinance-derived and is rendered as a BUY/SELL 'Final decision' banner at components/stock/quantlab/tabs/LlmTab.tsx:399-412. Separately, :317-319 forwards the END USER'S OWN LLM API KEY (held in sessionStorage, components/stock/quantlab/hooks/useQuantLabLlm.ts:180) to an operator-chosen third-party origin — including a 'managed fallback' the user never selected. Whether the LLM vendors' key-confidentiality terms are engaged by that is an I8 question, and NOT_APPLICABLE was answering it. Routing this solely to Q-092 was a misfile: Q-092's acceptance criteria are prompt-injection only and cannot reach it.

Infrastructure the operator provisions under their own agreement; it returns no vendor market data, so NOT_APPLICABLE holds FOR I8. CORRECTION: the first version said 'it stores OUR data'. entries.finding: UNOFFICIAL community client for the same undocumented, unauthenticated Yahoo endpoints as yahoo-finance2, with no key and no agreement. MISSED by the first version of this register, which read package.json and called it every dependency.

entries.finding: THE LARGEST AND MOST LITERAL REDISTRIBUTION ACT IN THIS PROJECT, and every other detector kind is blind to it. 57 tracked files, 13 MB, roughly five years of Yahoo-derived daily OHLCV per name (scripts/backtestData/AAPL.json carries ticker, sector, fetchedAt 2026-08-16 and raw candles). The repository is PUBLIC. .github/workflows/refresh-data.yml:135-137 stages scripts/backtestData/ and pushes to main WEEKLY from a bot, and every prior vintage is retained in git objects permanently, so withdrawal would require history rewriting rather than a delete. Bulk historical redistribution is the use market-data licences prohibit most explicitly. Recording this changed the shape of the whole package: the mechanism detects EGRESS, and I8 governs EXPOSURE — the difference is exactly this row.

field_definitions.end_user_exposed: TRUE when vendor-derived content can be obtained by an end user of this platform through ANY path — a route, a shared CDN cache, or a published artifact — regardless of whether it is labelled as vendor data. It is NOT 'is there a UI component for it'. Left undefined in the first version of this file, which produced systematic understatement.
field_definitions.authenticated: Describes the SURFACE WE SERVE: does a caller need to authenticate to obtain this data from us? It does NOT describe the credential we send outbound. Outbound credentials are recorded in the finding text. Conflating the two is how BLOOMBERG_BRIDGE_URL came to read authenticated:true while app/api/prices/route.ts:63 says 'Public endpoint, no authentication required'.
